Definition: The list of items, such as tiles, characters and 3D shapes, that can be added to a scene.
An item that has been chosen in the Palette but not placed yet. It can be moved before it is placed.
The marker in the scene editor that shows which spot the keyboard is working with.
Lines that divide the scene into equal squares, so items line up.
The item or items that keys and the Properties panel will change.
A number that says where something is along one direction: x (left and right), y (up and down) or z (toward and away).
The eye a game looks through. Only what the camera can see shows up on the screen.
A camera that shows everything at the same size, no matter how far away it is, like looking straight down at a map. 2D scenes use it.
A camera that makes near things look big and far things look small, the way your eyes do. 3D scenes use it.
